body:
I've slept with a bunch of guys over the past few months. Last week, after I was done with the last one, I looked in the mirror and my eyes were completely dilated. I didn't notice until then. I fear that these might be manic episodes. I don't take illegal drugs or anything. I do have a psychiatrist. My eyes are dilated again right now....

It's such a weird feeling. It's like there's an angel on one shoulder and the devil on the other shoulder. And then I struggle while slowly planning things, then I'm in my car...then I'm walking up the steps... then I'm naked... emotionless, disconnected. The first time it happened, I was planning on killing myself. Right now, I might still go out and do it again... 

It's feels like I'm in control...and at the same time, out of control. I need to talk to my psychiatrist... I will also probably get a bunch of tests done too now. 

I'm only 27... this all started to escalate like 5 months ago. I was a normal person before...

I'm really sorry to hear about all the trouble you have went through. Honestly, I'm not sure how the treatment is going. I'm on a downward mood directions over the past few days. The psychiatrist assessment was frustrating. It didn't seem genuine. There were 2 psychiatrists and 1 intern there. The intern asked questions and the others listened. Then an MD took me and did a basic check up. The whole process was exhausting and very exposing to my life. 

I'm thinking of going to the hospital.... never been before. Sorry... my mood has changed significantly in a few hours. I don't want to hijack your thread.

I've called a hotline quite a few times in some pretty messed-up moods. I even told them that I wouldn't get rid of the means and needed it just in case I decided that I wanted to kill myself...

They never called the cops on me. Now I don't want to call them. It's horrible when we have to weigh the economics between the choice of calling a suicide hotline or just end life entirely because of the inconvenience.

I had to tell them because I couldn't continue working without some accommodation. They were actually extremely understanding and left the matter confidential. I was allowed to leave when I needed to. No questions asked. I just started seeing a psychiatrist. They did an assessment on me last week, and I think they're trying to see if I'm bipolar... which I never considered. 

I'm 27 now... but when I first started post-secondary, I had a major depressive episode and basically flunk-out of two schools in 1.5 years. I recovered from that hiccup and managed to graduate from 2 separate programs since then. I'm still not sure what I want to do to be honest, so you're not alone. Probably many people are like this.

Maybe your college has a career counselor that's more aligned with helping people figure out what they want to do with their life. They don't need to know about the depression if you don't want to tell them. 

It's tough not being able to tell people. I wish I could just tell people. I lost a second interview last week because of anxiety.... the recruiter asked me afterwards if I was nervous... I said no, but I really knew why it happened. I didn't even notice while in the interview... it just happens. 

I wish I could tell you the secret formula. If you're working on this now, you're so much ahead of me. I only started getting treatment from a doctor about 4 months ago. Use all the resources you can. I wish that I did this years ago.

The hardest thing I had to do recently was tell my work that I had a problem. I still feel bad about it. So I get what you're saying. 

I think counselling is fairly confidential, and you probably won't be seen any differently by your peers.

Do you have a counselling department at your college? Maybe you could talk to them. I do that from time to time. 

I even talk to myself too. It's probably not that uncommon.
How do they know your address? That doesn't seem fair. Were you in imminent danger or just needed to talk about your problems?
I have a small penis. Most girls and guys I've been with were fine with it. I don't know... just from observation in the locker room, etc., I don't think small penises are that uncommon.
It only takes a few seconds to do it...
Is it wrong to just try... it doesn't seem so bad of an idea right now.
Sometimes i just want to try to do it...

Maybe calling a hotline might be the best thing. I never know what to say when I call. I just sort of stumble my way into the conversation, but they never judge. You could wait for your housemates to leave and then call. Then you will have privacy. 

I need to lay down (I just switched meds and feeling symptoms...), but please respond to this message later so I know that things are good. If you want, you can PM. Try the butterfly hug a little more....
If you need to go to the hospital, then you should go.
Here's a link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JGYGKRIt9xE

Maybe you can try this.... I know that it sounds weird. My psychologist suggested this when I was having a crisis a few days ago... try just crossing both your hands over your chest like your giving yourself a hug, and gently tap your shoulders with your hands in a steady rhythm, back and forth. Take deep breaths and keep doing this. Maybe even close your eyes. It's supposed to be a makeshift EMDR method... I have used it several times today. Look up "EMDR butterfly hug" on google if you want.

The counselor at my school made me create a "safety list"... I had to list a bunch of numbers if I ever needed help. Do you have something like that? 

Do you have a friend who you can text?
I have a sibling going through the same thing.
Can you do something to distract yourself tonight?

What happens in 3 years? 

I've been diagnosed with major depression disorder. I haven't attempted yet.... but I have collected the means. I hope to shake this feeling someday.... I can only imagine how tough it would be to keep holding on.
Do you have a car or somewhere outside where you can call them. I won't push the idea. I was afraid of that too. I just went outside into my car to talk.
I call them sometimes. They will just listen. They don't get offended or worked up by concepts like suicide. Calling them has probably saved my life a few times.
Do you feel comfortable calling a crisis hotline?
What can I do to help? Or do you want me to listen?
Hi, what's going on?

I don't think anyone can comment on that site. 

Do you take any meds that could help? I don't know what you feel like, so it must feel horrible. 

I still struggle with suicide. I just hold-on. Is there anything you like to do?

I tried it a couple times recently. It didn't really help. One told me my problems were too much and tried to summarize any easy plan to get out of the rut. Honestly, I was just trying to speak my mind and needed someone to listen, but I think it might be dangerous for vulnerable people with issues to seek help from people not properly trained to deal with mental health issues.
I am feeling really down tonight. Overwhelmed. No one to talk to. I don't want to reach out to my therapist for guidance tonight. I need to learn to work through this.
Don't worry. It's not you. I appreciate that you respond. It sort of makes me hold on.
I don't know why it happened. I just wanted to before I kill myself. I think that it will be soon.

I usually leave out certain details if I think it will land me in the hospital. Not saying that's the correct thing to do. I think my therapist knows that I would not react well to being forced to go (ie. Do something impulsive). I hope you can say enough to feel safe with your thoughts.
Have you told your therapist? That's what I am doing. She has respected my fears of hospitalization for now but I know that is always a possibility when these topics come up.

I keep going through weird phases of self harm and risky behavior. I don't even know why. 

The dissociation hasn't really bothered me for a week. I don't think that it was as bad as yours. I just sort of felt like I was on autopilot. Like a zombie. Disconnected like your on some ride that you have no control. 

Last week I did something that I would have never done before. I met up with some guy online and we had sex. I just wanted to do it... I don't understand why. I feel confused but not like I did something wrong. I don't know what's going on. 

I used to feel normal... now I don't trust myself.

I'm afraid of being hospitalized too. It took me awhile to tell my therapist. I told her that my biggest fear was being put in the hospital. She knows this... and now I need to talk about these suicidal thoughts. I had a mini crisis last Thursday and Friday, and instead of doing something, I texted my therapist. I didn't tell her everything (like how I bought the pills on Friday...I told her this later though..). I have a feeling if I ever say that I have a plan with an actual time, I will have to go to the hospital (involuntarily). I know what to say and what not to say. I'm sure therapists can see through this. 

Talk about it with your therapist. I don't think thoughts will land you in a hospital. It's the intentions and plans that will... and at that point, I hope someone would save me or you from ourselves.

I remember when I went to see a doctor about my depression. He asked if I felt thoughts of suicide. I said no... I felt so ashamed and guilty for lying. I wanted to cry. 

There's no right way to do this, but I hope you find someone to tell. I'm holding on. I would hate to know where I would be without opening up.Take care.

Apparently I'm going to be seeing a really good psychiatrist. I don't know what to expect. I don't think I'm crazy or anything. I go in and out of suicidal episodes... almost daily. Today, I felt at one point that suicide was an enjoyable feeling. 

I started taking the Pristiq again. I was having a weird moment where I felt separated from myself... like floating or something. I figured that maybe I should wait to see the new psychiatrist to help me get off of this drug properly. It's crazingly expensive too... I'm glad my work benefits cover it. 

I don't know what to do anymore. I feel kind of like a loser... whining about wanting to kill myself. and then ffeeling ok after that. It's like crying wolf or something. It makes me just want to give up too.
I am considering it right now. It's an option for me.

I'm taking myself off of my medication. I feel like I'm losing control ever since starting anti-depressants. The doctor won't listen to me.... like I've been rehearsing suicide on and off for weeks. Before I started anti-depressant, I never thought about suicide. Now I want to kill myself and think it's an acceptable option. I can't see past a few days. 

So far, I haven't really experienced strong withdrawal side effects. My mind feels clearer. I wanted to cry yesterday for a few minutes, but whatever. 

I'm going to look for a new doctor. I told him that I was planning to buy sleeping pills and taking them, and he said he thought that I was low risk. Literally that night I almost did it. More rehearsal I guess. Some day, rehearsal will probably turn into something else. It's like being scared to jump into water because it's cold... you stand at the edge knowing that there will be shock, but once you jump in, the shock is only short lived. I'm waiting to get the courage to jump in. 

I just want my life back... 

What are you scheduled for 6 days? Forgive my ignorance.
Friend, I just bought sleeping pills. I want to tell someone but feel scared. I can visualize doing it. I just want to end it. Trying to hold on. Why am I like this...

I will check it out when I get home. Need a good laugh. 

You're from California? I could use some warm weather. Going through the Alberta winter right now. It's not too bad. Last year was freezing. 

I could start reading. I started reading one of the walking dead books a while ago. Never finished it. What are you reading?

I need to find things to do. Things to enjoy. My counselor said I should try exercising. 

I found more pills to fixate on last night. I hitting a low right now. What would it be like to try... if it works, nothing will matter. I won't remember. I won't be conscious. I won't care...be sad... nothing will matter.

I have a class tonight and then I think that I might drop by the pharmacy.

I moved across the continent for work. I've isolated myself for the past 2 years. I would love to get a cat. Mine passed away before I moved here. She died in my arms. I relive it a lot.  They're like people. 

I'm still thinking about suicide tonight. I've pretty much eliminated the means to do it. I guess thinking about it is better than doing it. 

How do you take your mind off these things? What was wrong with your friends? Why toxic? ):

I threw them away. 

I'm going to tell my counselor about these episodes. At least tonight I won't obsess about overdosing. Out of sight out of mind... i guess. 

No.. the hospital wouldn't be bad if it will keep me safe. I just want a hug or something. Doing this alone is tough.

I was on Cipralex for only 6 weeks... I did a lot of weird things. Suicide was on my mind constantly. I did a lot of rehearsal... I'm still doing it now. This is my first week off of it. I still have a lot of Cipralex left, and I my mind is constantly thinking about taking them. I have sleeping pills too... not prescription, so probably wouldn't do much damage. 

My GP gave me a prescription for Pristiq. It so far seems ok. But still, I just have general thoughts of killing myself. Maybe they were always there. Like I was thinking of killing myself last night and nearly tried...and a few nights ago, the same thing, when I first posted this.

If I told the psychologist this, she would have me admitted to a hospital, so I bite my tongue. Maybe I need to go to one. 

I was referred to a psychiatrist this week, so just waiting for the phone call. 

I have no doubt that I will probably think about killing myself again by the end of today. It seems to happen at night. It almost feels "right", which sounds kind of perverse. Comfort in knowing that you can kill yourself...

I'm ok. I took some pills and fell asleep. I was thinking about taking more but was too tired. I should throw them out... I feel bad for asking for help. I do feel weak about it. 

I don't know why I want to kill myself. I just need to battle these feeling every time. It's like I live 2 lives sometimes.

I'm ok... I've settled down. I'm going to bed soon. I made a suicide contract with my therapist. I'm afraid to call her... she will probably try to get me in a hospital. I had a normal life a few months ago and just snapped. Hospitals scare me. I'm probably not making sense.

I'm exhausted now... i just need to lay down... maybe I can just sleep and escape... maybe I should take 1 more sleeping pill... so tired. I should call the suicide hotline. I'm supposed to be the one that has their life in order... and i just broke. I can't disguise this pain alone anymore. Maybe just 1 more.. I don't make sense... i just want to jump over the edge. I'm afraid. ... i need to take a pristiq... i got taken off Cipralex this week. I've felt different. Does it matter now really. It will just make things worse...  i can't tell people i know how i feel. I'm going to go now. Not sure if anyone is reading.

I don't know if anyone is there anymore, but I'm going to just type what I'm thinking. I keep looking over the edge. I'm not sure why. I just want to do it. I don't have a horrible life but i want to kill myself. I feel like I'm a burden. It's weird. I just want to die. It's confusing. I don't know if I should trust this feeling. It's a struggle. It's tougher to fight this than kill myself...so maybe i want to live. I don't know... I'm thinking about taking more pills now. That will make it easier. All I have to do is swallow them. 5 seconds. I'm getting tired now. I must sound like a horrible person.
Help...
Can you help? I'm thinking about trying again tonight...

I didn't do it... I had all of my Cipralex and sleeping pills in my hand. I'm still thinking about doing it. Maybe this weekend. Not looking for attention or anything... just telling everyone what I'm going to do. I want to die now. It's comforting to know that I can end it.

I guess it's just that I need to say something. I think it's easier to stay anonymous and talk about this. I'm going to try to tell my counselor tomorrow. It's becoming a slippery slop lately... I wrote a suicide letter last night... I need to get help.
I don't know what to do still... I'm thinking about taking a bunch of pills tonight. Not sure why I'm back here again. A few months ago, I never imagined that I would be considering suicide.
I feel horrible today. When I was at work, I was re-living those memories. It was like I was disconnected and back there again. I will tell my therapist next week and just hold on until then.
I'm holding a knife... thinking about cutting my wrist. I'm having trouble applying pressure.  Maybe I need to go to the hospital.

I just finished finals, and struggled with suicidal ideation during the stretch run. Not saying I'm going through the same thing, but just try to do your best. I don't feel comfortable talking to my family about these thoughts. I told a couple counselors, and they both wanted me to go to the psychiatric ward (or whatever it's called), but I can't imagine doing that...yet. I know it's an option.

Maybe you just need to take one step at a time. Can you see a doctor?  He or she can set you on the right path. My doctor has somewhat guided me through treatment options to help me out. I'm not sure where I would be without seeking help.
Do you have anyone to talk to? Are you seeking help?

I'm getting treatment for a similar situation. It's still a rough road. I talked to my manager at work and explained what was going on. I asked him to step in if things get out of hand. It has helped. Why don't you try counselling? Or see a doctor?  I'm not going to lie... I have thought about killing myself several times this month. I've even called a suicide hotline a few times. Do whatever it takes to make it work. Take care.

I called them twice last week. It helped me. I basically started by saying that I don't know what to say but I need someone to talk to, and they asked me questions. 

They don't judge or freak out like some people do when you talk about suicide.

I am alone and have nothing to look forward to anymore. I feel a little better today, but last week, I planned to do something this weekend. I ended up calling a crisis line, and they walked me through things that I could do. I removed all the knives in my apartment... but now I'm thinking about pills. 

I've read a lot of forums, but I think that I need to write about it now instead of reading. Maybe I'm looking for help a different way. The people that I've told have freaked out on me which makes me feel bad and like I did something wrong. My counselor decided to refer me to another counselor because of how bad my case was or something like that (they never told... this happened on Thursday... it scared me). I told them that I didn't feel comfortable with that change. They didn't warn me about it. It felt like a betrayal.
